correctness.rationale: For normalized Gaussian STFT, angular orthogonality diagonalizes every radial annulus on Hermite modes: lambda_j(a,s)=1/j!∫_a^(a+s)e^-u u^j du. Integration by parts gives lambda_(j+1)-lambda_j=p_(j+1)(a)-p_(j+1)(a+s), whose sign switches at most once from + to -, so the minimum on 0..K is min(lambda_0,lambda_K), with strict interior gap at their positive crossing for K>=2. The ratio lambda_K/lambda_0 grows strictly from below 1 to infinity, so unique a_K(s)>0 satisfies ∫_0^s e^-t(a+t)^K dt=K!(1-e^-s). At crossing lambda'_K=lambda_(K-1)-lambda_K>0, and lambda_K increases until crossing; lambda_0 decreases afterwards, establishing global unique maximin and bottom eigenspace span{h0,hK}. For fixed s, a/K->1/e from Stirling; uniform bounded-t limit gives J_s=∫_0^s e^((e-1)t)dt and log corrections as claimed. Independently checked numerical crossing and intermediate-mode inequalities at K=2,3,8,40, with no extrapolation of finite checks to large K; K100 naive incomplete-gamma evaluation underflows, so excluded as evidence.
